title: LUNARIS actual deployed-app demonstration
method: Actual anonymous Chrome recording of the deployed application: real ten-site selection, planning controls, Sun/Earth views and original/delayed/recovered decisions. Editorial crops, cuts, short still-frame holds and readable captions; 30 fps H.264 encoding. No generated imagery, voice or invented application behavior.
ai_assistance: AI-assisted development and caption writing. Deterministic application decisions; no runtime AI.
limits: Illustrative mission requirements. Center visibility is not power, RF link performance, landing safety or reachable trajectory; seven separate cases are not universal robustness.
coverage: 10 terrain-aware study points; 426-day scientific bundle; nine additional geometry-only context locations.
encoding_tools: FFmpeg 9.0.2 libx264; actual duration and stream dimensions verified using ffprobe.
